brand.name: Harborwell
brand.tagline: Care that meets you at home.

hero.title: Care, with room to live.
hero.description: Personalized medical and everyday support that helps older adults and people with ongoing health needs stay connected to home.
hero.imageAlt: Home health nurse speaking warmly with an older man

about.title: Care begins by listening.
about.description: Harborwell brings clinical insight and practical support into the place where routines already make sense. We learn what matters to each person, coordinate with family and providers, and build a plan that can change as needs do.
about.imageAlt: Older couple discussing a home care plan

services.title: Support shaped around the day.
services.description: Start with the help that matters now. We can coordinate services as routines, recovery, or health needs evolve.

items.title: Personal care
items.description: Respectful help with bathing, dressing, mobility, meals, and daily routines.

items.title: Companion support
items.description: Conversation, errands, light household support, and steady social connection.

items.title: Skilled nursing
items.description: Medication support, monitoring, wound care, and recovery guidance in the home.

items.title: Respite for families
items.description: Dependable short-term coverage so family caregivers can rest, work, or travel.

items.title: Older adult care
items.description: Steady support for aging in place, mobility changes, memory needs, and the routines that preserve independence.

items.title: Disability support
items.description: Flexible assistance that respects autonomy, communication preferences, and personal goals.

items.title: Chronic condition care
items.description: Day-to-day monitoring and coordination for conditions that benefit from consistent attention.

approach.title: One plan, held by a real team.
approach.description: A clear path from the first conversation to ongoing, responsive support.

steps.title: Listen first
steps.description: A care coordinator learns the person, the home, and the concerns behind the call.

steps.title: Build the plan
steps.description: We match the right level of support, schedule, and caregiver skills to the situation.

steps.title: Begin with care
steps.description: The first visits establish routines, preferences, and clear family communication.

steps.title: Stay connected
steps.description: We check in, share meaningful updates, and adapt the plan as needs change.

imageBand.imageAlt: A nurse sharing a positive moment with a client at home
imageBand.quote: The best care supports the whole rhythm of a life.

stories.title: What steadier days can feel like.
stories.description: Notes from families who needed care to be both capable and human.

items.quote: Our coordinator noticed the small routines that help my father feel in control. That changed everything about the transition.
items.name: Dana M.

items.quote: We receive useful updates without feeling like home has become a clinic. The balance is exactly what we hoped for.
items.name: Aaron P.

items.quote: Respite care gave me enough space to be a daughter again, not only the person managing every appointment.
items.name: Elise W.

contact.title: Tell us what home needs right now.
contact.description: A care coordinator will listen, answer practical questions, and help you identify a useful next step.
